title: HtmlSelect
responsibility: Renders the native select element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlSelect.attributes
inputs.description: Native select attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlSelect.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native select element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlSelect
outputs.description: The actual native select element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
